review_status: Compiled from public portals on 14 Oct 2026; awaiting Aventrix sign-off. Set a row's status to 'draft' to withdraw it.
methodology: All figures are online ASKING-price indicators published by property portals or developers. None is a government guideline value or registered transaction price.
One value per publisher: a stated average is used as-is; a stated range is reduced to its midpoint.
low = lowest publisher value, high = highest publisher value, mid = (low + high) / 2. The range is the spread between sources, not a statistical min/max of transactions.
A row is 'published' only when at least two independent publishers report a figure. Single-source rows stay 'draft' and are never used by the calculator.
Confidence 'medium' = 3+ publishers including a dated portal locality page, with sources within 35% of each other; otherwise 'low'.
Apartment rates are as listed on portals, which normally quote super built-up (saleable) area. Land rates are per sq.ft of plot area; 1 ground = 2,400 sq.ft.
Not checked: Magicbricks (access blocked) and 99acres (pages could not be retrieved). Square Yards pages for Velachery, Selaiyur, T. Nagar, ECR and OMR could not be retrieved.

coverage_gaps.commercial: No portal page found with per-locality commercial sale (capital) values for these localities; only office rents were available. No commercial rate is published.
